title: India's steel expansion sharpens focus on raw material security
dek: S&P Global reports that India's steel capacity expansion is sharpening attention on securing raw material supplies.
summary: S&P Global reports that India's steel expansion is bringing raw material security into sharper focus. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the specific materials, volumes or policy measures discussed are not stated.
whyItMatters: Capacity growth on the scale India targets would raise requirements for iron ore, coking coal and other inputs, much of which, in coking coal's case, is typically imported. Supply security could therefore become a constraint on expansion plans.
implications: Producers may look to long-term contracts, overseas assets or captive mines; traders should watch for shifts in input sourcing and pricing. The headline alone does not indicate specific actions.
